plan.rationale: Sierra Apologist EP. 2 — Berner T6 frame on 'decentering' (@domovang 766k plays). Sierra reframes ghosting as 'holy discernment' — Catholic-coded specific. P56 visual: SIERRA TALKING TO CAMERA FROM HER PARKED CAR (Wardrobe C post-Pilates). Confessional dashboard angle = perfect mismatch between the 'thriving' framing and the actual content (she's literally hiding in her car ghosting him). The visual is the joke before the script lands.
plan.voiceover_text: I'm a decentering apologist. They say it's manipulative. Or selfish. Maybe a bit cold. I call it holy discernment. Yes, he did text 16 times. He thinks I'm at brunch. I was at adoration. Try that once.
plan.caption: They call it 'playing games.' I call it ensuring he's ready for the full Sierra Frost experience. Some things are worth the wait.
